watchme.trigger: every pulse reaching the librarian's shim — the probe reads the refutation census from the librarian's own tree store (its component, its read), counting from an ERA FLOOR set to the MEASURED serving-process restart (ps lstart), never the disk landing (the 2026-08-08 stale-process lesson, applied at arming time). It fires a finding on any of three conditions: (a) one or more refutations have landed and stand un-adjudicated — the finding carries each one with its evidence, its refuter and the node it retired, so the question 'was this refutation itself wrong?' reaches the one instrument that can answer it; (b) >= 20 resolve crossings have accumulated since the era floor with ZERO refutations landed (the decorative tell — the behaviour built but never exercised); (c) refutations exceed 10% of the tree's nodes, or any single crossing lands more than one (the storm tell — the standing gate not holding).
watchme.enough: cleared by BOTH halves witnessed once each plus Akien's verdict: >= 1 refuted node observed in a later walk, returned present and labelled and not counted (the record holds AND the read honours it), AND >= 3 landed refutations adjudicated by Akien with his verdict on whether any was itself wrong. An existence claim on the mechanism and a measured answer on the question no code here can settle.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier (the default carrier), depositing the refutation census (count, refuters, retired nodes, evidence strings), the witnessing walk that returned a refuted node uncounted, and Akien's adjudications verbatim
watchme.nexus: the hypothesize tree via the chart deposit door (python3 -m cairn.machines.chart.live learn)
watchme.consumer: Akien, and the surface is part of the spec rather than an implementation detail: the finding fires into the SESSION-OPEN gate list he already passes every session (bin/cmd/slate renders it), never into a packet awaiting a visit — CLAUDE.md's own residue records that 'nothing makes me open a packet; the hook sees packets that exist, not rulings never recorded', so a human-nexus probe that files and waits inherits a known-failing intake. Secondarily the sieve-learning direction: the adjudicated refutation rate is the evidence that would move a hand-set gate, per I-learns-its-gates.
